text:
Alyssa: seeing a ~2x p99 tail increase on eu-w1 A10 pool after deploy of PR-4921 (kernel selector refactor). started ~10:30 UTC. throughput steady but latency spikes for multi-turn chat workloads.
Rajesh: thanks — noticed CI perf for merge job had a small regression in l4-kv microbench but we dismissed as noise. linking the job: http://ci.internal/runs/98421 (perf delta +12% p99)
Marta: can confirm canary eu-w1 had the same pattern around 10:15, but us-west canaries were fine. looks region/hw specific.
Alyssa: quick traces show a bunch of KV cache evictions correlated with short bursts of packet reorders on the host NIC. also seeing kernel choice flip back/forth on warmup.
Devon: interesting — PR-4921 changed the kernel picker to prefer k-vbatch kernel when estimated batch_size > 4 and net RTT < 600us. if RTT estimation is noisy because of packet reordering, it might mis-classify and pick wrong kernel.
Rajesh: started a narrow bisect locally. preliminary points to this block in selector:

if (est_batch > 4 && est_rtt_us < 600) return KERNEL_TYPE_KV_BATCH;
if (kv_cache_hit_ratio < 0.8) return KERNEL_TYPE_SINGLE_STREAM;

Changing thresholds reproduces spike in perf microbench.
Marta: CI job artifacts show elevated `tcp_retrans` and `rx_missed` counters on a subset of A10 hosts around the window. cc ops.
opsbot: flagged noisy-hosts group: a10-eu-w1-3a, a10-eu-w1-7b had NIC driver interrupts climbing. Opened ticket ENGR-1273.
Alyssa: repro steps I used:

./bin/infer_local --model redwood/v1-small --seq 1024 --concurrency 16 --profile
# observe kv cache churn and p99 increase

output excerpt:

KVCache: hits=78% evicts=22% kv_spill=1.2/s
kernel: selected=KV_BATCH then SINGLE_STREAM then KV_BATCH (within 200ms)

Devon: two mitigation ideas: 1) short-term revert the selector refactor (simple revert PR ready) 2) add an RTT smoothing window and detect multipath NIC reorder by checking `tx:rx` ring reorder counters before applying aggressive batch kernel.
Rajesh: bisect shows reverting that single conditional (the est_rtt_us < 600 check) brings p99 back to baseline in perf microbench. good candidate for revert+cherry.
Marta: can we toggle a runtime feature flag instead of full revert? helps for Dedicated customers.
Alyssa: feature flag `enable_kv_batch_selector_v2` exists; we can flip off in eu-w1 for emergency rollout. will we lose throughput benefits in normal cases? yes but preferable to 2x p99.
ci-bot: perf-ci detected the merge regression at 2026-03-18T09:12:23Z — job 98421 artifacts: http://ci.internal/artifacts/98421 ; flamegraphs attached.
Devon: attaching suggested quick patch to add RTT smoothing (window=1s) and multipath guard (if reorder_rate > 0.5%) — should reduce misclassifications. still want revert in patch release so customers stable.
Rajesh: ordering for action: 1) flip feature flag in eu-w1 2) open revert PR for selector refactor 3) land smoothing patch behind flag 4) monitor for KV eviction rate fall.
Marta: I'll coordinate with oncall to flip flag and annotate the rollout blocker. tagging security/ops for the noisy hosts ticket.
Alyssa: thanks — once flag flip is done I'll run the same local repro and report numbers. if p99 returns to baseline we'll proceed with revert+followup patch. :thumbsup:
Devon: logging note — add a short telemetry key `kernel_pick_reason` to help postmortems (values: latency_est, batch_size_est, kv_hit_ratio) so future rollouts easier to debug. small PR incoming.
opsbot: ENGR-1273 updated, noisy-host mitigation scheduled (NIC firmware probe + host drain if needed).
Rajesh: thx all. will draft revert PR and tag release-candidate.
Alyssa: updating thread after flag flip and one perf run.
